items.text: DATA, STATUS and CHANGES: every source, its licence and age in one table; the dot by the clock lists a screen's sources

NEWS and HOME: new stories arrive as they come, LIVE in the title strip
WHY: the 10 biggest daily moves of the year and what came out each day
GUESS: one mystery stock a day from its 1-year chart
SINCE on HOME: what moved since your last visit
WEIRD: period row, full-panel gauge charts and record lines
Chart N flags: headlines on 1D and 5D, other 8-Ks on daily charts
PRO: seats, yearly plan, gift codes, REDEEM, CHAT, SPONSOR and FEEDBACK
WORLDMAP: a dark world map of index moves, chokepoint ships and storms
FISHTANK: the S&P 100 as fish
ALERTS: price and gauge alerts, kept in this browser
TRENDING: the tickers people open most here
DESK: WEIRD gauges as cards and preset desks
WEIRD: 23 live odd-data gauges and share cards
Charts: 1-minute bars, zoom, measure, candles, volume, compare and event flags
